name: Thyrocare Technologies Ltd
about: Thyrocare Technologies is engaged in the business of healthcare industry and is involved in providing quality diagnostic services at affordable costs to patients, laboratories and hospitals in India.
keyPoints: Business Segments 1) Diagnostic Testing Services (92% in FY25 vs 94% in FY22): [1] [2] The company is one of the leading Pan-India diagnostic chains, offering a range of tests focused on early disease detection and health management. It provides 929 tests and 288 profiles, including 43 wellness packages under the “Aarogyam” brand. It processes 3 Bn investigations annually and can process 10 Bn annually. [3] [4]
pros: Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 131%
cons: Stock is trading at 15.6 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -9.90%

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 24 Nov - Sarovar Chandra designated CTO and SMP; Piyush Singh ceases SMP, effective Nov 24, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS 6 Nov
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Change in Management 6 Nov - Chief Scientific Officer Dr. Preet Kaur resigns; last working day November 6, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript 2 Nov - Please find attached the Earnings Call Transcript held on October 29, 2026

Execution Of Share Purchase Agreement In Relation To The Sale Of The Company'S Entire Shareholding In Nueclear Healthcare Limited, A Wholly Owned Subsidiary Of The Company 30 Oct - Thyrocare signed SPA on Oct 30, 2026 to sell 100% of Nueclear Healthcare for about Rs.141.4 crore.
